15: package caddyfile
16: 
17: import (
18: 	"bufio"
19: 	"bytes"
20: 	"fmt"
21: 	"io"
22: 	"regexp"
23: 	"strings"
24: 	"unicode"
25: 
26: 	"github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2"
27: )
28: 
29: type (
30: 	// lexer is a utility which can get values, token by
31: 	// token, from a Reader. A token is a word, and tokens
32: 	// are separated by whitespace. A word can be enclosed
33: 	// in quotes if it contains whitespace.
34: 	lexer struct {
35: 		reader       *bufio.Reader
36: 		token        Token
37: 		line         int
38: 		skippedLines int
39: 	}
40: 
41: 	// Token represents a single parsable unit.
42: 	Token struct {
43: 		File          string
44: 		origFile      string
45: 		Line          int
46: 		Text          string
47: 		wasQuoted     rune // enclosing quote character, if any
48: 		heredocMarker string
49: 		snippetName   string
50: 	}
51: )
52: 
53: // Tokenize takes bytes as input and lexes it into
54: // a list of tokens that can be parsed as a Caddyfile.
55: // Also takes a filename to fill the token's File as
56: // the source of the tokens, which is important to
57: // determine relative paths for `import` directives.
58: func Tokenize(input []byte, filename string) ([]Token, error) {
59: 	l := lexer{}
60: 	if err := l.load(bytes.NewReader(input)); err != nil {
61: 		return nil, err
62: 	}
63: 	var tokens []Token
64: 	for {
65: 		found, err := l.next()
66: 		if err != nil {
67: 			return nil, err
68: 		}
69: 		if !found {
70: 			break
71: 		}
72: 		l.token.File = filename
73: 		tokens = append(tokens, l.token)
74: 	}
75: 	return tokens, nil
76: }
77: 
78: // load prepares the lexer to scan an input for tokens.
79: // It discards any leading byte order mark.
80: func (l *lexer) load(input io.Reader) error {
81: 	l.reader = bufio.NewReader(input)
82: 	l.line = 1
83: 
84: 	// discard byte order mark, if present
85: 	firstCh, _, err := l.reader.ReadRune()
86: 	if err != nil {
87: 		return err
88: 	}
89: 	if firstCh != 0xFEFF {
90: 		err := l.reader.UnreadRune()
91: 		if err != nil {
92: 			return err
93: 		}
94: 	}
95: 
96: 	return nil
97: }
98: 
99: // next loads the next token into the lexer.
100: // A token is delimited by whitespace, unless
101: // the token starts with a quotes character (")
102: // in which case the token goes until the closing
103: // quotes (the enclosing quotes are not included).
104: // Inside quoted strings, quotes may be escaped
105: // with a preceding \ character. No other chars
106: // may be escaped. The rest of the line is skipped
107: // if a "#" character is read in. Returns true if
108: // a token was loaded; false otherwise.
109: func (l *lexer) next() (bool, error) {
110: 	var val []rune
111: 	var comment, quoted, btQuoted, inHeredoc, heredocEscaped, escaped bool
112: 	var heredocMarker string
113: 
114: 	makeToken := func(quoted rune) bool {
115: 		l.token.Text = string(val)
116: 		l.token.wasQuoted = quoted
117: 		l.token.heredocMarker = heredocMarker
118: 		return true
119: 	}
120: 
121: 	for {
122: 		// Read a character in; if err then if we had
123: 		// read some characters, make a token. If we
124: 		// reached EOF, then no more tokens to read.
125: 		// If no EOF, then we had a problem.
126: 		ch, _, err := l.reader.ReadRune()
127: 		if err != nil {
128: 			if len(val) > 0 {
129: 				if inHeredoc {
130: 					return false, fmt.Errorf("incomplete heredoc <<%s on line #%d, expected ending marker %s", heredocMarker, l.line+l.skippedLines, heredocMarker)
131: 				}
132: 
133: 				return makeToken(0), nil
134: 			}
135: 			if err == io.EOF {
136: 				return false, nil
137: 			}
138: 			return false, err
139: 		}
140: 
141: 		// detect whether we have the start of a heredoc
142: 		if !inHeredoc && !heredocEscaped && len(val) > 1 && string(val[:2]) == "<<" {
143: 			if ch == '<' {
144: 				return false, fmt.Errorf("too many '<' for heredoc on line #%d; only use two, for example <<END", l.line)
145: 			}
146: 			if ch == '\r' {
147: 				continue
148: 			}
149: 			// after hitting a newline, we know that the heredoc marker
150: 			// is the characters after the two << and the newline.
151: 			// we reset the val because the heredoc is syntax we don't
152: 			// want to keep.
153: 			if ch == '\n' {
154: 				heredocMarker = string(val[2:])
155: 				if !heredocMarkerRegexp.Match([]byte(heredocMarker)) {
156: 					return false, fmt.Errorf("heredoc marker on line #%d must contain only alpha-numeric characters, dashes and underscores; got '%s'", l.line, heredocMarker)
157: 				}
158: 
159: 				inHeredoc = true
160: 				l.skippedLines++
161: 				val = nil
162: 				continue
163: 			}
164: 			val = append(val, ch)
165: 			continue
166: 		}
167: 
168: 		// if we're in a heredoc, all characters are read as-is
169: 		if inHeredoc {
170: 			val = append(val, ch)
171: 
172: 			if ch == '\n' {
173: 				l.skippedLines++
174: 			}
175: 
176: 			// check if we're done, i.e. that the last few characters are the marker
177: 			if len(val) > len(heredocMarker) && heredocMarker == string(val[len(val)-len(heredocMarker):]) {
178: 				// set the final value
179: 				val, err = l.finalizeHeredoc(val, heredocMarker)
180: 				if err != nil {
181: 					return false, err
182: 				}
183: 
184: 				// set the line counter, and make the token
185: 				l.line += l.skippedLines
186: 				l.skippedLines = 0
187: 				return makeToken('<'), nil
188: 			}
189: 
190: 			// stay in the heredoc until we find the ending marker
191: 			continue
192: 		}
193: 
194: 		// track whether we found an escape '\' for the next
195: 		// iteration to be contextually aware
196: 		if !escaped && !btQuoted && ch == '\\' {
197: 			escaped = true
198: 			continue
199: 		}
200: 
201: 		if quoted || btQuoted {
202: 			if quoted && escaped {
203: 				// all is literal in quoted area,
204: 				// so only escape quotes
205: 				if ch != '"' {
206: 					val = append(val, '\\')
207: 				}
208: 				escaped = false
209: 			} else {
210: 				if (quoted && ch == '"') || (btQuoted && ch == '`') {
211: 					return makeToken(ch), nil
212: 				}
213: 			}
214: 			// allow quoted text to wrap continue on multiple lines
215: 			if ch == '\n' {
216: 				l.line += 1 + l.skippedLines
217: 				l.skippedLines = 0
218: 			}
219: 			// collect this character as part of the quoted token
220: 			val = append(val, ch)
221: 			continue
222: 		}
223: 
224: 		if unicode.IsSpace(ch) {
225: 			// ignore CR altogether, we only actually care about LF (\n)
226: 			if ch == '\r' {
227: 				continue
228: 			}
229: 			// end of the line
230: 			if ch == '\n' {
231: 				// newlines can be escaped to chain arguments
232: 				// onto multiple lines; else, increment the line count
233: 				if escaped {
234: 					l.skippedLines++
235: 					escaped = false
236: 				} else {
237: 					l.line += 1 + l.skippedLines
238: 					l.skippedLines = 0
239: 				}
240: 				// comments (#) are single-line only
241: 				comment = false
242: 			}
243: 			// any kind of space means we're at the end of this token
244: 			if len(val) > 0 {
245: 				return makeToken(0), nil
246: 			}
247: 			continue
248: 		}
249: 
250: 		// comments must be at the start of a token,
251: 		// in other words, preceded by space or newline
252: 		if ch == '#' && len(val) == 0 {
253: 			comment = true
254: 		}
255: 		if comment {
256: 			continue
257: 		}
258: 
259: 		if len(val) == 0 {
260: 			l.token = Token{Line: l.line}
261: 			if ch == '"' {
262: 				quoted = true
263: 				continue
264: 			}
265: 			if ch == '`' {
266: 				btQuoted = true
267: 				continue
268: 			}
269: 		}
270: 
271: 		if escaped {
272: 			// allow escaping the first < to skip the heredoc syntax
273: 			if ch == '<' {
274: 				heredocEscaped = true
275: 			} else {
276: 				val = append(val, '\\')
277: 			}
278: 			escaped = false
279: 		}
280: 
281: 		val = append(val, ch)
282: 	}
283: }
284: 
285: // finalizeHeredoc takes the runes read as the heredoc text and the marker,
286: // and processes the text to strip leading whitespace, returning the final
287: // value without the leading whitespace.
288: func (l *lexer) finalizeHeredoc(val []rune, marker string) ([]rune, error) {
289: 	// find the last newline of the heredoc, which is where the contents end
290: 	lastNewline := strings.LastIndex(string(val), "\n")
291: 
292: 	// collapse the content, then split into separate lines
293: 	lines := strings.Split(string(val[:lastNewline+1]), "\n")
294: 
295: 	// figure out how much whitespace we need to strip from the front of every line
296: 	// by getting the string that precedes the marker, on the last line
297: 	paddingToStrip := string(val[lastNewline+1 : len(val)-len(marker)])
298: 
299: 	// iterate over each line and strip the whitespace from the front
300: 	var out string
301: 
302: 	heredocBody := caddy.ToString(val)
303: 	stateRepl := caddy.NewEmptyReplacer()
304: 	stateRepl.Set("heredoc.marker", marker)
305: 	stateRepl.Set("heredoc.padding", paddingToStrip)
306: 	stateRepl.Set("heredoc.body", heredocBody)
307: 	storedMarker, foundMarker := stateRepl.Get("heredoc.marker")
308: 	if foundMarker {
309: 		marker = caddy.ToString(storedMarker)
310: 	}
311: 	storedPadding, foundPadding := stateRepl.Get("heredoc.padding")
312: 	if foundPadding {
313: 		paddingToStrip = caddy.ToString(storedPadding)
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	paddingTabs := 0
317: 	paddingSpaces := 0
318: 	paddingOther := 0
319: 	for _, paddingRune := range paddingToStrip {
320: 		if paddingRune == '\t' {
321: 			paddingTabs++
322: 		} else if paddingRune == ' ' {
323: 			paddingSpaces++
324: 		} else {
325: 			paddingOther++
326: 		}
327: 	}
328: 	paddingProfile := strings.Builder{}
329: 	if paddingTabs > 0 {
330: 		paddingProfile.WriteString("tabs")
331: 	}
332: 	if paddingSpaces > 0 {
333: 		paddingProfile.WriteString("spaces")
334: 	}
335: 	if paddingOther > 0 {
336: 		paddingProfile.WriteString("other")
337: 	}
338: 	stateRepl.Set("heredoc.padding_profile", paddingProfile.String())
339: 
340: 	markerValid := 0
341: 	markerInvalid := 0
342: 	for _, markerRune := range marker {
343: 		if unicode.IsLetter(markerRune) {
344: 			markerValid++
345: 			continue
346: 		}
347: 		if unicode.IsDigit(markerRune) {
348: 			markerValid++
349: 			continue
350: 		}
351: 		if markerRune == '-' {
352: 			markerValid++
353: 			continue
354: 		}
355: 		if markerRune == '_' {
356: 			markerValid++
357: 			continue
358: 		}
359: 		markerInvalid++
360: 	}
361: 	stateRepl.Set("heredoc.marker_valid_count", markerValid)
362: 	stateRepl.Set("heredoc.marker_invalid_count", markerInvalid)
363: 	if markerValid > 0 {
364: 		marker = string(replaceEnvVars([]byte(marker)))
365: 	}
366: 
367: 	paddingBytes := make([]byte, len(paddingToStrip))
368: 	copy(paddingBytes, paddingToStrip)
369: 	paddingToStrip = string(paddingBytes)
370: 
371: 	lineTokens := make([]Token, 0, len(lines))
372: 	for lineIdx, lineValue := range lines {
373: 		if lineIdx == len(lines)-1 {
374: 			continue
375: 		}
376: 		copied := make([]byte, len(lineValue))
377: 		copy(copied, lineValue)
378: 		lineTokens = append(lineTokens, Token{
379: 			Line:          l.line + lineIdx + 1,
380: 			Text:          string(copied),
381: 			wasQuoted:     '<',
382: 			heredocMarker: marker,
383: 		})
384: 	}
385: 	lineDisp := NewDispenser(lineTokens)
386: 	literalRepl := caddy.NewEmptyReplacer()
387: 
388: 	for lineNum, lineText := range lines[:len(lines)-1] {
389: 		lineDisp.Next()
390: 		errLine := l.line + lineNum + 1
391: 		rawLine := lineDisp.ValRaw()
392: 		if lineDisp.Token().Quoted() {
393: 			if rawLine == lineText {
394: 				lineText = rawLine
395: 			}
396: 			if lineDisp.isNewLine() {
397: 				errLine = lineDisp.Line()
398: 			} else {
399: 				if lineDisp.Line() > 0 {
400: 					errLine = l.line + lineNum + 1
401: 				}
402: 			}
403: 		}
404: 		lineText = literalRepl.ReplaceKnown(lineText, "")
405: 
406: 		copiedLine := make([]byte, len(lineText))
407: 		copy(copiedLine, lineText)
408: 		var rebuilt strings.Builder
409: 		rebuilt.Grow(len(copiedLine))
410: 		scanPos := 0
411: 		for scanPos < len(copiedLine) {
412: 			if scanPos+1 < len(copiedLine) {
413: 				if copiedLine[scanPos] == '{' {
414: 					if copiedLine[scanPos+1] == '$' {
415: 						closeIdx := strings.Index(string(copiedLine[scanPos+2:]), "}")
416: 						if closeIdx >= 0 {
417: 							spanEnd := scanPos + 2 + closeIdx + 1
418: 							rebuilt.Write(copiedLine[scanPos:spanEnd])
